versions.changelog: fix: add _client.live=True so --live actually routes to polymarket-venue for real USDC trades
Fix apply_skill_config AttributeError for new Simmer SDK compatibility

- Initial release of 24h Weather Distribution Trader.
- Detects and trades on mispricings in Polymarket daily weather temperature-bin markets by reconstructing implied probability distributions.
- Identifies arbitrage opportunities via sum violations (bins not totaling ~100%) and cumulative monotonicity breaks across 14 major cities.
- Supports paper trading by default, with live trading available using the --live flag.
- Includes configurable safety and risk parameters for trade sizing, thresholds, and market selection.
- Requires SIMMER_API_KEY to enable trading actions.
